title: Vision-Language Models under Cultural and Inclusive Considerations

bias_targets.methodology: Filtering the VizWiz dataset to isolate images containing implicit cultural concepts across 60 different cultures, and evaluating zero-shot VLM image captioning performance using both automatic metrics (BLEU, CIDEr, METEOR, SPICE) and human evaluations to assess cultural awareness and representation.

Surveying visually impaired individuals to identify their specific needs and preferences for image descriptions, and evaluating whether VLM-generated captions effectively and accurately serve this demographic as AI-powered visual assistants.
